text.tspan: From PromQL to a Slack message
group_wait 30s: batch the first alerts of a group
group_interval 5m: new alerts in an existing group
slack_configs: api_url_file (webhook URL in a Secret),
inhibit: critical mutes matching warnings (equal labels)
Test: amtool check-config · amtool config routes test severity=critical · amtool alert add TestAlert …
or curl -XPOST localhost:9093/api/v2/alerts. Silence maintenance: amtool silence add … --duration=2h.
Alert on symptoms, every alert has severity + owner + runbook; critical → pager, warning → Slack.
